Export audio clips and spectrograms for the sampled events (WAV + FLAC)

Source: R/05_validation_export.R
pam_validation_export.Rd

For every row of validation_samples.csv whose files are missing, cuts a clip (event plus validation$clip_pad_s seconds of context on each side) from the audio the run read, and draws a spectrogram PNG with FFmpeg. Dynamically uses -c:a flac or -c:a pcm_s16le based on the target clip file extension. Existing files are kept, so it can be rerun after each new round.

Usage

pam_validation_export(cfg, run_id = cfg$birdnet$run_id, force = FALSE)

Arguments

cfg

A pam_config object.

run_id

Detection run.

force

Recreate all files.

Value

Invisibly, list(n_ok, n_failed, failed_ids).

Examples

# \donttest{
if (nzchar(Sys.which("ffmpeg"))) {
  ex <- pam_example_project()
  # the later stages read the master table that the scan builds
  res <- suppressMessages(pam_scan_audio(ex$cfg))
  proc <- suppressMessages(pam_process_detections(ex$cfg))
  new <- suppressMessages(pam_validation_draw(ex$cfg, strategy = "random", n = 3))
  out <- suppressMessages(pam_validation_export(ex$cfg))
  out$n_ok
}
# }
